name: Spirit Army buffs Spectral Warden's summon count, duration and absorb (#3145)
contract: Spell 707634 (Spirit Army) carries three native ADD_FLAT/ADD_PCT_MODIFIER effects, family 36,
classmask matching Spectral Warden's (805716) own SpellFamilyFlags (128 in flags0, 16384 in flags1):
BasePoints -8001 -> -8000 ms) and SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (op 12, ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, BasePoints 99 -> +100%
absorb). All three ops are applied generically by the core (Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers for
SPELLMOD_EFFECT1/2, the core duration path for SPELLMOD_DURATION), so no CoA script is required:
learning the passive talent alone should move all three modifiers.

steps.label: SETUP: no summon-count modifier on Spectral Warden before learning the talent
SETUP: no duration modifier on Spectral Warden before learning the talent
SETUP: no absorb modifier on Spectral Warden before learning the talent
Spirit Army adds +2 to Spectral Warden's summon count
Spirit Army reduces Spectral Warden's duration by 8000 ms
Spirit Army doubles Spectral Warden's absorb amount
